exposure: sperm preparation technique (swim-up washing procedure, microfluidics sperm sorting)
cohort: The study included 326 couples with unexplained infertility who underwent intrauterine insemination.
finding: The study found non-significant worse reproductive results (live birth rate = 12% vs 20%) using microfluidic sperm selection compared to the pellet swim-up technique.
gest_age: The majority of live births (n=47 out of 51) were delivered at term.
